title: Fieldwise Mastery, Unyielding Progress!
description: At Collei's invitation, you and Paimon arrive at the venue of the Akademiya's newly-established "Fieldwise Center," ready to participate in its further development...

mainQuestExcel.title: Fieldwise Mastery, Unyielding Progress!
mainQuestExcel.description: At Collei's invitation, you and Paimon arrive at the venue of the Akademiya's newly-established "Fieldwise Center," ready to participate in its further development...

dialogs.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon! Over here!
Welcome to the home base of the "Fieldwise Center"!
As you can see, the core projects are already up and running, so we can get to work at any time!
Huh... This feels like... one of those places light novels talk about. Y'know, the adventuring hubs where rookies gather to take quests and stuff?
Oh! And almost like a school festival at the same time, with everyone getting together to learn and then forming teams to hone their skills... Hehe, it's so exciting!
Yeah, I'm pumped!
Well, this place isn't quite as decked out as a school festival, but Master Tighnari said the Akademiya plans to be generous with the resources.
Anyway, before students and researchers head out on dangerous field missions, they can come here for advice and emergency training...
We even have professionals on staff that can join their teams to serve as guides or safety personnel.
Yeah, you can think of it like a "Forward Operating Base" — equal parts theoretical training and field practice!
We'll familiarize new recruits with potential challenges in the wild and take them through drills so there's no reason to panic during the real thing!
Amber? You're here, too?
Is the Outrider getting new job responsibilities?
Haha, surprised? I know I was!
I'm off duty right now, so I was planning to just drop in on Collei for a bit...
But, I didn't realize how busy she'd be! I'm not the type of person to sit around and watch. So, I decided to be her assistant!
Sorry, Amber. I didn't mean to put you to work during your time off...
Don't worry about it! A little relaxation balanced out with some fulfilling work is a great vacation in my book! Plus, I've learned a whole bunch of stuff, too!
#And, I got to see {NICKNAME} and Paimon again! I mean, it just keeps getting better!
We should have a giant feast once we're done here. How does that sound?
Hehe, a feast with the first friend we met in Sumeru, and the first friend we met on our whole journey...
That sounds just about as awesome as a giant plate of Sticky Honey Roast!
Well, we should get this show on the road, then.
Alright! Down to business, then...
Collei and I are in charge of the scouting speedsters project. The focus is using devices and machines to pass through hazardous areas, survey terrain, and get details on potential threats.
Plus, Amurta research indicates that, during dangerous situations, having the support of an adorable companion can help set adventurers' minds at ease and prevent excess nerves...

So, we took inspiration from Cuilein-Anbar and Baron Bunny to create two scouting devices that are both adorable and useful — "Cuilein An-bot" and "Bar-drone Bunny". So far, feedback has been pretty positive!
Once we've collected enough data, the Akademiya will continue to refine the Scouting Buddies and release even more designs!
A bunch of Cuilien-Anbars and Baron Bunnies running around the wilderness... What is that gonna look like?
Like a sight for sore eyes, no doubt!
Plus, with you to guide our two little scouts, we'll be able to obtain some great data.
Once you have a more complete understanding of the Fieldwise Center, you should come test them out.
Now, come with me. I'll introduce you to the other consultants.
Oh, yeah! The lady with the greenish-blue hair also has a super adorable device over there!
But, it does something completely different than our scouting buddies.
I'm looking forward to seeing it in action!
Oh, hey! Another familiar face!
C'mon! Let's go say hi!
It's kind of hard to picture...
Let's work hard, so we can feast harder.
You've been calling in reinforcements from far and wide, Collei!
What kind of light novels have you been reading, Paimon...
...It's really that popular?
The internal locomotion mechanism is clever enough, and the execution on the terrain recognition, remote control, and weight detection modules isn't bad...
But, the appearance... It might as well be a doll for a child. No, this won't do...
Madam Faruzan! Great news—
#{NICKNAME} and Paimon agreed to join! The Fieldwise Center just leveled up big time, huh?
Hehe! Hello, Madam Faruzan! We're here to help!
Well, look who the cat dragged in...
Excellent job, Collei! Snagging two top experts with undeniable adventuring expertise... Now, the League won't be able to say a word, no matter what kind of feedback I give!
Now, tell me... What do you think of this "Puzzlepal"?
Whoa... It looks just like you!
It makes me feel safe and comfortable.
It's a collaboration between my juniors in the Haravatat Darshan, the Puzzlers' League, and the Synopsium on Ruin Mechanisms.
Clearly, the technological aspect is quite advanced, but the appearance... it couldn't be more childish.
You should've seen Anis! Defending this design choice with more passion than her thesis...
Hmph, young people these days... Far too obsessed with making things cute.
Huh, Paimon kinda likes it!
Collei and Amber were just saying how cute companions can help adventurers stay calm.
With a doll that looks like you by her side, Paimon thinks she could go adventuring in a super dark ruin and not even get scared...
Well, that line of thinking does have merit. And, I suppose choosing this particular appearance is a sign of their respect... Ahem, for me.
Still, there are adventurers who place greater emphasis on reliability and technical composition.
People like that don't just want their devices to be able to survive an avalanche, but to look the part... and for their appearance to reflect the high-tech composition.
The fluffiness of this Puzzlepal, on the other hand, doesn't give the impression it would be a reliable or formidable device. The appearance may even be distracting.
Now, picture this... A thick metal casing, square in shape, with a matte finish and openings to showcase the complex technical composition... That would have much more visual impact.
I'm the perfect example of this. I have a youthful appearance, and so people question me on occasion. If I had a head of white hair instead, things would be different.
R—Really? Then, do you want Paimon to talk to them? She has white hair...
What? No! That... That's not the same thing!
Uh... I didn't realize you had such... strict views about this, Madam Faruzan.
I think it looks good as it is.
Huh? So... even you prefer this version?
Ahem... Well...
If that's what you really think, then... Fine!
#You'll have to come back and test it out on some puzzles, {NICKNAME}.
I'll rate your effectiveness in using the device and come up with a user manual based on your performance...
As for improvements to its appearance, long-term observation is required, so I'll put that aside for now.
I'll do my best!
I've already selected a few of the most suitable Domains, so we can begin the puzzle-solving process at any time.
#Thanks, Madam Faruzan. I'm just gonna take {NICKNAME} and Paimon to see the final project... But, it shouldn't take long!
Don't worry, Collei! You're the one in charge here, just make sure to pace yourself.
Once things calm down, come over to see me, and we'll have a nice chat. I'll even treat you to some snacks from back in my day.
Snacks!? Paimon's in, Paimon's in!
Thank you, Madam Faruzan. I'll bring a few boxes of floral tea as well!
Go on now. Do me proud!
I'll be sure to make the most of the Puzzlepal's capabilities!
Maybe we can save the square model for next time.
It barely looks like adventuring gear at all.
Hmm, I should adjust the legs so Bar-drone Bunny can run even faster!
This last one is a long-term project we're calling the Security Division.
Thanks to General Mahamatra Cyno, we've been able to bring Dehya on as the instructor and Candace as the coordinator.
They're putting together a combat test right now, but they should be back soon...
Hey! Looking for us? Guess we showed up right on cue, then!
#Wait, {NICKNAME} and Paimon are joining as well? That makes things a whole lot easier!
Sorry for keeping you waiting, everyone, but we managed to bring back some good intel.
Intel? Whew, this is starting to sound intense.
That's the type of prep you do before a major battle...
Are we planning some sort of offensive?
Of course! What better way to protect the students than to sweep through the desert and rid it of all potential dangers! Not a bad plan, right? You in?
Not the best time for jokes, Dehya.
#Besides, when it comes to striking down danger, {NICKNAME} is a {M#man}{F#woman} on a mission. {M#He}{F#She} might take you up on that offer...
#Defeating anything that might pose a threat... Even if {NICKNAME} worked non-stop, that could still take years!
We'd have to stop traveling... Paimon doesn't even wanna think about that...
After all, the desert's just too big...
Who knows how many enemies there are...
Time would be the least of our problems. Some dangers aren't visible to the naked eye, like the scorpions burrowed underground, or the terrifying raptors sleeping in the trees...
You can't get rid of them until they jump out to attack you!
For situations like these, we'd have to combine Madam Faruzan's recommendations with Amber's approach to scouting, calculating our chances of encountering enemies and our expected operation times...
Whoa, whoa, whoa. Pencils down, everyone! That was just a joke!
The Security Division's goal is a lot simpler, actually. We're just here to ensure that field work teams include trained combat personnel.
Some of this work has been entrusted to the Blazing Beasts and other mercenaries, but members of investigation teams who pass the combat test can also qualify.
Before an investigation team is allowed to head into a dangerous area, the group must include at least two professionals who have passed the assessment.
And, Dehya and I were just out collecting intel on the best place to hold the test.
We found a Domain filled with monsters and bandits of all levels. Hopefully, they don't mind us borrowing their stomping ground for bit. It'll only cost 'em a few smacks on the head, haha.
Oh, so we just need to supervise, right?
That's right. Participant safety is our utmost priority, so we'll organize a group of capable personnel to take it in shifts.
We still need to figure out our testing metrics, though. Fighting is different from an actual exam — and there's no one right answer.
Mercenaries like me... We all have our own style. That's not a problem in actual combat, but when it comes to teaching... We tend to stick too much to what we're used to.
So we need someone to give us a baseline... someone who has the experience but also takes a more flexible approach in combat.
That's my specialty! Leave it to me!
I'm here to help as much as I can.
#Yeah, based on what you just described, {NICKNAME} seems like the perfect person for the job!
#Great! Working with you is always a pleasure, {NICKNAME} — smooth as butter on a steak!
#Don't forget about compensation for {NICKNAME} and Paimon, Dehya. You agreed without doing the math first.
Ah, it's fine! We'll just split the funds Collei wrangled for us twenty-eighty. Ten for me, ten for you, eighty for the two of them.
Wait, we're getting eighty percent?
That seems like a bit much...
Thank you for your generosity, Dehya!
Hahaha! Don't sweat it!
We're just in charge of the long-term operations. You're the ones setting the metrics for the whole thing, so I think we got the better end of the deal, haha.
We've talked about a partnership in the past, haven't we? Well then, consider this the perfect place to start.
Th—Then, I'll draw up a detailed overview of the compensation so it's clear for everyone.
That'd be great!
And don't worry, Miss Candace.
About that piece of land you're leasing to the Akademiya, the one used for grain storage... I managed to get them to agree to a thirty percent increase in the rent payment.
Ah, thank you. Those funds will go to fixing up some of the village facilities, which should make for a more comfortable experience when investigation teams stop there in the future.
#Alright, we should finish up our arrangements for the combat test. Stop by our station when you're ready, {NICKNAME}.
See you soon!
Ah, you sure are the beating heart of this operation, Collei! You brought the whole gang together!
Oh, no, no... I'm just doing what I can.
I still have so much to learn, so much work to coordinate...
But, for now, let's just give it our all!
You bet! Hehe, we'll make the Fieldwise Center the best it can be!
Hmm... Perhaps we shouldn't change it after all...
Hmm, I should adjust the legs so Bar-drone Bunny can run even faster!
